en.content:
The charge/size ratio of a cation determines its polarizing power. Which one of the following
sequences represents the increasing order of the polarizinig order of the polarizing power of the
cationic species, K<sup>+</sup>, Ca<sup>2+</sup>, Mg<sup>2+</sup>, Be<sup>2+</sup>?
en.explanation:
As charge/size ratio of a cation determines its polarizing power so high charge and small size of the cations increases polarisation.

As the size of the given cations decreases as

K+ > Ca2+ > Mg2+ > Be2+

Hence, polarising power decreases as

K+ < Ca2+ < Mg2+ < Be2+

en.content: Which of the following sets of quantum numbers represents the highest energy of an atom?
en.explanation:
In which quantum number have highest ( n + l ) value, will represent highest energy of an atom.

In option (C), n + l = 3 + 2 = 5 = maximum.
